summary: 34BigThings' high-speed anti-gravity racing series, inspired by F-Zero, Wipeout, Rollcage, and POD, including the main Redout racers and the Space Assault spin-off.

entries.title: Redout
entries.definitive_edition: Redout: Enhanced Edition on Windows with owned DLC

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows; use VR support only if desired and available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings with DLC

primary.version: Redout: Enhanced Edition with owned DLC
primary.why: Redout released first on Windows, later on PS4, Xbox One, Switch, and Amazon Luna. Windows is the highest-fidelity route, supports VR, and is the best path for the full DLC-expanded track/team set.
primary.how_to_play: Play Redout: Enhanced Edition on Windows at the highest stable settings with owned DLC installed; use console/Switch/cloud routes only as access alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Lightspeed Edition bundles some DLC on PS4/Xbox One, but Windows with owned DLC remains the most complete route.

entries.title: Redout: Space Assault

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Redout: Space Assault launched through Apple Arcade on iOS and macOS, then later came to Windows, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox One. Windows is the highest-fidelity route for the space-combat spin-off.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use Apple Arcade/mobile, Switch, PS4, or Xbox One only as access alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Spin-off space-combat entry rather than an anti-gravity racing sequel.

entries.title: Redout 2
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Redout 2 released for Windows, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route for the sequel.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with owned DLC installed; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives and Switch only for portable play.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster beyond the original platform releases; install owned DLC for completeness.
